status.description: waiting: the half is kept for 2 minutes. connected: it met the owner's half. already_connected: the two were connected before. same_kind: the two aren't of different kinds, or, connecting across groups, are in the same group, so nothing is kept. no_group: connecting across groups, and either isn't in a group, so nothing is kept
